sentences.en: Behind the sand dunes there is a swamp where herons look for food.
sentences.ko: 모래 언덕 너머에 백로가 먹이를 찾는 늪이 있어요.

sentences.text: Dulu kompleks rumah Ayu adalah rawa yang ditimbun tanah.
sentences.en: Ayu's housing complex used to be a swamp that was filled in with soil.
sentences.ko: 아유네 주택 단지는 예전에 흙으로 메운 늪이었어요.

sentences.text: Penjual cendera mata menawari Eko hiasan dari tanduk kerbau.
sentences.en: A souvenir seller offered Eko an ornament made from buffalo horn.
sentences.ko: 기념품 상인이 에코에게 물소 뿔로 만든 장식품을 권했어요.

sentences.text: Kambing milik tetangga punya tanduk yang melengkung.
sentences.en: The neighbor's goat has curved horns.
sentences.ko: 이웃집 염소는 뿔이 휘어 있어요.

sentences.text: Kelompok pecinta lingkungan mengajak Eko menanam benih bakau di pantai.
sentences.en: An environmental group invited Eko to plant mangrove seedlings on the beach.
sentences.ko: 환경 단체가 에코에게 해변에 맹그로브 묘목을 심자고 했어요.

sentences.text: Ayu dan Bu Sri saling bertukar benih sayuran setiap musim hujan.
sentences.en: Ayu and Mrs. Sri swap vegetable seeds every rainy season.
sentences.ko: 아유와 스리 아주머니는 우기마다 채소 씨앗을 서로 바꿔요.
